brief: FIRST read animations/SHARED.md. (Already built — being revised to the bigger scale; see SHARED.md SCALE.)

FIRST read animations/SHARED.md and look at the style + reference images it lists. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene. Spoken: 'And if you're new to AI, don't worry. Skills are just an easy way of repackaging instructions and resources and giving it to your agents.' (exact times in words.txt). BEAT A (0–1.6 s): secondary speaker card (hf/assets/speaker.mp4) floats top-centre; kinetic serif below: 'if you're' small, 'new to AI,' huge Fraunces italic ocean (lands on 'new' ~0.38), 'don't worry.' Newsreader ~130px (lands ~1.14). BEAT B (1.6–6.5 s): card + text clear quickly; the explainer: on 'Skills' (~1.74) a big deep-teal card labelled 'SKILL.md' (Geist mono, ocean dot) rises centre and opens (lid/fold or the card splits open) on 'repackaging' (~3.31). On 'instructions' (~3.99) three white instruction strips fly in and drop into it — use these REAL headings from the actual taste-skill SKILL.md (hf/assets/skillmd.png shows the file): '0. Brief inference', '0.A Read these signals first', '0.D Anti-default discipline'. On 'resources' (~4.58) four small resource chips fly in on arcs and drop in: an 'Aa' type chip, a colour-swatch chip, an image chip, a '</>' script chip. The card seals (~5.0). On 'giving it to your agents' (5.4–6.1) the sealed SKILL.md card slides along a drawing dotted path into a black round agent puck (simple robot face: two ocean eye-dots) which lights ocean and bobs on 'agents' (~6.1). Kinetic serif labels appear as they're spoken near their objects: 'instructions' and '+ resources' (Newsreader ~96, accent italic on one), 'to your agents.' (Fraunces italic ~140). Hold alive to the cut.

FIRST read animations/SHARED.md. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene. Spoken: 'You also don't have to be a genius to set up a skill. Just copy these links and give them to your agents and they should be able to use them immediately.' BEAT A (0–2.3): HERO speaker card (~900x620, hf/assets/speaker.mp4) top; kinetic below: 'you don't have to be a' Newsreader ~96, 'genius' Fraunces italic ocean ~250 landing on 'genius' (~0.91) with a hand-drawn dotted ellipse drawing around it, then 'to set up a skill.' ~90px (~1.6–2.05). BEAT B (2.4–6.5): card shrinks/slides to a small card top-left (keep it, it's the speaker); on 'links' (~3.13) five white link pills pop in a stagger (link icon + these REAL repo slugs, Geist): 'Leonxlnx/taste-skill', '0xdesign/design-plugin', 'jamiemill/layers-skills', 'MengTo/Skills', 'Nutlope/hallmark'. Cursor clicks one on 'copy' (~2.55, a tiny 'Copied ✓' flash). On 'give them to your agents' (3.55–4.2) the pills fly on arcs into the black agent puck (robot face, ocean eyes). On 'use them immediately' (5.37–5.77) five black notification pills stack in (like the reference's notification stack; white Geist text, ocean check): '✓ taste-skill ready', '✓ design-and-refine ready', '✓ layers-skills ready', '✓ Meng To skills ready', '✓ hallmark ready' — 3 f stagger, last one lands on 'immediately' (~5.77). Hold alive.

FIRST read animations/SHARED.md. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — skill #1. Spoken: 'First one is Taste Skill. I've personally used this a lot, especially for designing my own personal website. And it has helped reduce slop a lot.' CHAPTER (0–1.3): coin 01 rolls in and turns ocean (~220px), 'first one' Newsreader small, 'Taste Skill' Fraunces italic ~220 lands on the name (~0.69). PAGE (1.3–4.9): the REAL page hf/assets/taste_site.png (tasteskill.dev, 1080 wide tall screenshot) in a large tilted browser card (URL 'tasteskill.dev'), slow internal scroll; a black pill '★ 94.5k on GitHub' pops beside it (real number from the repo page hf/assets/taste.png); a secondary speaker card (hf/assets/speaker.mp4) tucks in at a lower corner overlapping the browser card; kinetic serif: 'I've personally used this a lot,' then 'for my own personal' + 'website.' (Fraunces italic ocean, lands ~4.47). SLOP (5.0–6.8): browser card + speaker clear; a messy pile of ~8 identical bland grey UI cards (same hero→3 boxes→button rhythm, slightly scattered/overlapping) fills the middle; on 'reduce' (~5.73) they get swept/vacuumed away in a stagger leaving ONE crisp deep-teal designed card that settles centre; the word 'slop' Fraunces italic ink ~230 appears (~6.11) and an ocean strike-through draws across it; 'a lot.' small. Hold alive.

FIRST read animations/SHARED.md and look at style_refine.png (this skill's approved still). FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — skill #2. Spoken: 'Second one, Design and Refine. It actually makes five variations of any UI from my code base. I pick what I like and then it merges it into my entire code base.' CHAPTER (0–1.5): coin 02 turns ocean, 'second one' small, 'Design' Newsreader + '&' Fraunces italic ocean + 'Refine' landing on the words (0.55–1.05), repo slug '0xdesign/design-plugin' Geist muted; behind it optionally the REAL README hf/assets/refine.png in a tilted browser card, softly. VARIATIONS (1.6–5.2): five white UI variation cards (each a different wireframe layout) deal into a fan one by one, last lands on 'variations' (~2.65–2.9); kinetic '5 variations' ('5' Fraunces italic ocean ~200). On 'from my code base' (4.09–4.93) a black pill '</> your codebase' slides under the fan with dotted lines drawing up to each card. PICK (5.3–6.3): the white cursor arcs in and clicks card 2 (~5.36) then card 4 (~5.9) — each lifts and flips to deep teal with ocean accents; kinetic 'pick what you like,' Newsreader. MERGE (6.36–7.6): the two picked cards fly together and fuse into one larger deep-teal card on 'merges' (~6.58) with a soft ocean flash + 'merged' black pill; the unpicked cards fade back; 'it merges them' kinetic with 'merges' Fraunces italic ocean ~180. (7.6–8.47): the merged card drops into the codebase pill with an ocean ✓ on 'code base' (~7.9–8.16). Hold.

FIRST read animations/SHARED.md. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — skill #3. Spoken: 'Third one, Layers. This is built on good UX and product design principles and it gives your AI agents direction.' CHAPTER (0–0.9): coin 03 turns ocean, 'third one' small, 'Layers' Fraunces italic ~240 lands ~0.51. STACK (0.9–4.0): seven soft isometric slabs (white card material, soft shadows; top one ocean) stack bottom-up with a satisfying drop-and-settle each, spread across 'built on good UX and product design principles' (UX ~1.93, product ~2.53, design ~2.83, principles ~3.19). Label each slab with the REAL layer names from the Layers framework (Geist, small, ink; see hf/assets/layers_site.png): 01 Observed behaviour, 02 The domain, 03 User needs, 04 Product & service strategy, 05 Conceptual model, 06 Interaction structure & flow, 07 Surface. Kinetic serif beside the stack: 'good UX' ('UX' Fraunces italic ocean), '& product design principles'. DIRECTION (4.0–5.7): the black agent puck (robot face, ocean eyes) lands on top of the stack; an ocean arrow/compass needle swings from it and points up-right along a drawing dotted path; 'direction.' Fraunces italic ocean ~200 lands on ~5.37. Hold alive.

FIRST read animations/SHARED.md. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — skill #4. Spoken: 'Fourth one, Meng To skills. There are a whole bunch of skills here, but my favorite is the one that you can record a screen and just give it to your agent to actually go and build that website for you.' CHAPTER (0–1.3): coin 04 turns ocean, 'fourth one' small, 'Meng To' Fraunces italic ~220 + 'skills' Newsreader (0.6–0.88). BUNCH (1.4–2.6): the REAL repo page hf/assets/mengto.png in a tilted browser card (URL 'github.com/MengTo/Skills'); around it skill-name chips pop in fast (white pills, Geist) with REAL names from the repo: 'Video to Super Prompt', 'HTML to Interaction Prompts', 'Stitched Full Page Capture', 'Daily UI Inspiration', 'browser-video-recording', 'audit-reference-originality'; kinetic 'a whole bunch of skills'. FAVOURITE (2.66–4.0): everything else falls/fades away; 'Video to Super Prompt' chip grows to centre and turns ocean; 'my favorite' Fraunces italic. RECORD (4.3–5.2): a landscape screen-recording card appears (a soft wireframe website inside, scrolling; red REC dot + Geist timer counting up) on 'record a screen' (~4.30–4.76). AGENT (5.36–6.4): the REC card slides along a dotted path into the black agent puck (robot face, ocean eyes) which hums. BUILD (6.6–8.0): a big browser card builds a website block by block (nav bar, hero headline bar, image block, three cards, button) in a fast satisfying stagger, deep teal + ocean + white; last block lands on 'website' (~7.44); 'build that website for you.' kinetic with 'website' Fraunces italic ocean. Hold.

FIRST read animations/SHARED.md. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — skill #5. Spoken: 'Fifth one is Hallmark. You can run an audit of your design and they'll give you all the things that you should improve and then go ahead and improve it.' CHAPTER (0–1.0): coin 05 turns ocean, 'fifth one' small, 'Hallmark' Fraunces italic ~230 lands ~0.49; optionally the REAL site hf/assets/hallmark_site.png ('Make your AI agent a designer.') in a tilted browser card behind/below. AUDIT (1.0–2.6): a white UI design card (a bland generic layout) centre; on 'audit' (~1.47) an ocean scan line sweeps down it with a soft glow and small grey markers pin to problem spots; kinetic 'run an audit' ('audit' Fraunces italic ocean). LIST (2.67–4.3): a checklist card slides out beside it with 4 rows, each with a grey ✗ (Geist): 'Generic layout', 'Weak hierarchy', 'Default styling', 'Cramped spacing'; rows stagger in through 'all the things you should improve'. IMPROVE (4.45–5.53): rows flip to ocean ✓ one by one, fast; the design card morphs into a polished deep-teal version; 'improve it.' Fraunces italic ocean ~200 lands on 'improve' (~5.15). No numeric score. Hold.

FIRST read animations/SHARED.md. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — wrap-up. Spoken: 'You just need to give your AI agents good design sense and taste and they will not build slop for you. These skills will help you do that. Literally just copy and paste these into Claude or Codex or whatever agent you use.' BEAT A (0–4.5): HERO speaker card (~900x620, hf/assets/speaker.mp4) top; kinetic stack below: 'give your AI agents' Newsreader ~96, 'good design sense' ~110 with 'design' Fraunces italic, '& taste' Fraunces italic ocean ~250 (lands on 'taste' ~2.68), then 'they will not build' ~90 and 'slop' Fraunces italic ink ~230 (lands ~3.98) with an ocean strike-through drawing across it. BEAT B (4.6–6.0): text clears; the speaker card shrinks to centre (~560px) and the five coins 01–05 fly in and orbit it on a drawing dotted ring (like the reference's 01-02-03 orbit), landing through 'these skills will help you do that' (4.73–5.6). BEAT C (6.1–10.17): card moves up small; a black rounded prompt box appears (generic, no brand UI) with a blinking caret; the cursor pastes on 'paste' (~6.91): five white skill chips (Taste Skill, Design & Refine, Layers, Meng To, Hallmark) drop into the box; then three plain text pills pop below it (no logos!): 'Claude' (~7.65), 'Codex' (~8.35), 'any agent you use' (~9.0–9.8); kinetic 'copy & paste' with 'paste' Fraunces italic ocean. Hold alive.

FIRST read animations/SHARED.md. FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE scene — CTA, last shot of the reel. Spoken: 'Comment design and I will send these straight to your inbox.' (speech ends ~2.4 s; hf/assets/speaker.mp4 freezes on its last frame from 2.43 s to the end). Composition like the reference's ending: 'Comment' Newsreader ~150 ink centred (lands ~0.0–0.1, already visible by frame 3), then '“design”' Fraunces italic ocean ~230 lands on 'design' (~0.21) with overshoot; a hand-drawn dotted line draws down (0.4–1.0) to a tilted secondary speaker card (~620x430); on 'send these straight to your inbox' (1.15–2.17) the five coins 01–05 slide into a small black pill '→ your inbox' with a satisfying stack; kinetic 'I will send these straight to your' small + 'inbox' Fraunces italic ocean ~140 (~2.17). From 2.43 to the end keep secondary life (coins float, dotted line shimmer, gentle push) — no exit, the reel ends on this frame.
